description: Client-side JavaScript code for user interface interactions in the vtiger CRM system, including widget management, form handling, and dynamic UI updates.

methods.name: set_return
methods.description: Sets report-to user information in the parent window.

methods.name: updateWidgetWindow
methods.description: Updates the widget content area based on selected heading, manages iframe source and form controls.

methods.name: saveWidget
methods.description: Validates the company logo upload before saving widget.

methods.name: checkB4Submit
methods.description: Displays an alert and returns true, possibly a placeholder for pre-submit validation.

methods.name: updateWidgets
methods.description: Sends AJAX request to update widget list and updates the DOM with response.

methods.name: showhide
methods.description: Toggles display of UI layers, changing plus/minus indicators.

methods.name: closeWindow
methods.description: Closes current window and reloads the opener.

methods.name: manageWidgets
methods.description: Handles widget enable/disable via AJAX based on checkbox state.
